regions.license: Eurostat reuse terms; verify before redistribution.
regions.notes: Current checked-in regions are a complete 8-region set verified offline against Eurostat LAU 2025.

districts.notes: District coverage is intentionally incomplete seed data.

municipalities.license: Eurostat reuse terms; verify before redistribution.
municipalities.notes: Municipality coverage is expanded from the official Eurostat LAU 2025 workbook. District codes are not supplied by the source and remain null in the imported dataset.

psc.notes: PSC coverage is expanded beyond the original tiny seed-only sample, but it still does not imply national coverage. Source rows may repeat the same postal code, so importer previews should preserve ambiguity with matchCount and matches. Imported PSC records currently have districtCode null because the source does not provide a reliable district mapping. Source/licence verification is still pending.

banks.notes: Bank data remains a small non-exhaustive seed set.

holidays.notes: Holiday data currently covers 2024-2026 and is curated offline.
